Turkey, bacon, avocado and secret sauce.How to make it12 slices of white sandwich bread250g shaved roast turkey6 rashers of streaky bacon1 avocado, sliced2 tomatoes, sliced4 iceberg lettuce leaves4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp sriracha1 tbsp pickle relishFry the bacon until crisp and toast the bread.Stir the mayo with the sriracha and relish for the secret sauce.Build triple-deckers: sauce, turkey and lettuce, then toast, then bacon, avocado and tomato.Pin with toothpicks and cut each into 4 triangles.Let off some steam pork bunsLet off some steam, Bennett. Steamed bao, sticky pork belly, cucumber.How to make it600g pork belly, skin off60ml soy sauce60ml hoisin sauce2 tbsp brown sugar3 garlic cloves, crushed1 thumb-sized piece ginger, sliced500ml water12 frozen bao buns1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced thin2 tbsp rice vinegar2 tbsp roasted peanuts, crushed1/2 cup coriander leavesBrown the pork belly all over in a heavy pot.Add the soy, hoisin, sugar, garlic, ginger and water, cover and simmer gently until tender.Lift out the pork, reduce the liquid to a sticky glaze and slice the pork thickly into it.Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar, and steam the buns.Fill the buns with pork, cucumber, peanuts and coriander.All handsVal Verde mojo chickenArius wants Matrix back in Val Verde. Citrus garlic chicken, black beans and rice.How to make it1.2kg chicken thighs, bone in, skin on2 oranges, juiced2 limes, juiced6 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp dried oregano60ml olive oil300g long grain rice2 x 400g tins of black beans1 brown onion, diced1 green capsicum, diced1/2 cup coriander leavesMix the citrus juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, oil and salt and marinate the chicken for at least 2 hours.Roast the chicken at 200°C, skin side up, until crisp and cooked through, basting with the marinade.Soften the onion and capsicum, add the beans with their liquid and simmer until thick.Cook the rice and serve with the chicken, beans and coriander.Green Berets for breakfast huevos rancherosMatrix eats Green Berets for breakfast. Fried eggs, salsa roja, beans, green chilli.How to make it8 eggs8 small corn tortillas400g tin crushed tomatoes1 brown onion, diced2 garlic cloves, crushed1 chipotle in adobo, chopped400g tin refried beans100g feta, crumbled2 long green chillies, sliced1 avocado, sliced3 tbsp vegetable oilSoften the onion and garlic in a little oil, add the tomatoes and chipotle and simmer to a thick salsa.Warm the beans and fry the tortillas in a little oil until just crisp at the edges.Fry the eggs sunny side up in the rest of the oil.Spread beans on the tortillas, add the eggs and spoon the salsa round, then top with feta, green chilli and avocado.RationedI let him go tres lechesMatrix tells Cindy he let Sully go. Milk-soaked sponge, coconut cream, lime.How to make it5 eggs, separated200g caster sugar125ml milk150g self-raising flour395g tin sweetened condensed milk375ml tin evaporated milk270ml tin coconut cream300ml thickened cream1 lime, zested2 tbsp toasted coconut flakesBeat the yolks with 150g sugar until pale, then stir in the milk and fold in the flour.Whisk the whites with the rest of the sugar to soft peaks and fold through. Bake in a lined 20 by 30cm tin at 175°C until springy.Prick the warm cake all over and pour over the condensed milk, evaporated milk and coconut cream, mixed. Chill overnight.Whip the cream and spread over, then finish with lime zest and coconut.LoggedFly or die seaplane rum punchMatrix gets the seaplane up: fly or die.
